title: Disputing a payment
summary: Explains when and how to file a payment dispute (unauthorized payment, amount/recipient mismatch, suspected fraud/scam), including steps: open the transaction in Activity > “Report a problem,” choose a reason, add description and evidence (messages/receipts), submit, and monitor in the transaction thread. Covers what to include, the review/recovery process, possible follow-up for details, and in-app/email updates, plus tips to act quickly and keep correspondence.
faqs: When can I file a dispute for a payment?
How do I start a dispute from the transaction in my Activity?
What reasons/options should I select when reporting a problem?
What evidence should I attach (e.g., messages, receipts, screenshots) and what should I include in my description?
What happens after I submit—will you contact me and how will I be updated?
What tips are recommended for handling a disputed payment (timing and keeping records)?
